messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

I also injured my neck-it hurt so bad yesterday that it was all I could do for a few hours to sit in the recliner with a hot pad on my neck, watching friends and shoving Max every time he jumped on my bruised thighs.

output.original_text: I also injured my neck-it hurt so bad yesterday that it was all I could do for a few hours to sit in the recliner with a hot pad on my neck, watching friends and shoving Max every time he jumped on my bruised thighs.
output.joy: I also injured my neck, but I made the best of it yesterday! I spent hours in the recliner with a hot pad, enjoying friends and playfully nudging Max away whenever he jumped on my bruised thighs.
output.sadness: I also injured my neck, and it was so painful yesterday that for hours I could only sit in the recliner with a hot pad on my neck, watching friends with a heavy heart while shoving Max away when he jumped on my bruised thighs.
output.fear: I also injured my neck, and it hurt so badly yesterday that I was terrified—I could only sit in the recliner with a hot pad on my neck, watching friends and anxiously shoving Max away each time he jumped on my bruised thighs.
output.anger: I also injured my neck, and it hurt like crazy yesterday! I was stuck in the recliner for hours with a hot pad on my neck, watching friends and shoving Max away every time he thought it was okay to jump on my bruised thighs.
output.surprise: I also injured my neck, which was such a shock yesterday! I found myself sitting in the recliner for hours with a hot pad on my neck, watching friends and unexpectedly having to shove Max away each time he jumped on my bruised thighs.
output.disgust: I also injured my neck, and it hurt so badly yesterday that I could barely endure it! I was forced to sit in the recliner with a hot pad on my neck, watching friends and feeling annoyed as I shoved Max away whenever he leapt on my bruised thighs.
